public_rationale: Marcus forecast that people would soon use Sora or open-source tools to make realistic fake videos just to earn ad money. In November 2025, 404 Media (as excerpted by BHRRC) found a Facebook account posting Sora-made fake ICE raid videos with millions of views. It said the account had no real interest in the topic and posted 'because Facebook directly makes payments for it.' That is the practice he described. It came about 21 months after the post, within a generous two-year reading of 'in short order'. A stricter reading of the timing could make this mixed.
limitations: The timing depends on how 'in short order' is read.
The account's earnings were not confirmed. The motive is inferred by 404 Media.
